content.subject: Volunteer workshop
content.body:
Dear Mr. Halow,
As you suggested in the last meeting, you will organize a workshop about the Safety Procedure and it is advised that all of us should attend to gain more experience. Before signing to the workshop, I want to know more about it. Please email me back with further details. Hope to hear from you soon!
content.instruction: Respond to this email as if you are John Harlow. In your email, provide at least THREE pieces of information about the workshop.

content.subject: Product return
content.body:
To who it may concern,
I recently purchased a battery for my camera from your Web site. The online description said that the battery would be compatible with my camera, but it's the wrong size. What do I need to do to return this battery and get the right one for my camera?
Thanks,
Robert Bremen
content.instruction: Respond to the e-mail as if you are a customer service representative. In your e-mail, give TWO pieces of information and ask ONE question.

content.question:
Which of the following activities do you think you must try when visiting a new city?
- Eating at a local restaurant
- Shopping in the neighborhood
- Going on a guided tour
What are some disadvantages of attending a school located far from your hometown?
